vaults.name: Vicky at Web Summit
vaults.what: A vault app that shows what an HTML vault app can do: it verifies its own files' sha256 in the browser, reads its own history, proves its sandbox live and draws itself. Audited before every push.

vaults.name: Vicky's research vault (newsroom)
vaults.what: The Web Summit 2026 newsroom's research desk: one capture per public source (the summit, Portugal, Europe, announcements), each with its URL and read date. Kept by researcher@web-summit.vicky; audited before every push.
